Palestine ❤️ New Zealand: Tell es-Sultan and Wadi Qelt meet Piha's black-sand coast. Close hugs, linked hands, short flag-cut looks, rainbow boots and RAZE platforms. Fictional AI fashion; the distant smoke is imagined.

assets.selectionReason: Meta selected after the single comparison because its RAZE band is retained; the edited comparison removes this detail and introduces an unrolled star tattoo. Both versions remain archived.
assets.alt: Four fictional adult women overlap in a close side hug beside the archaeological terraces of Tell es-Sultan, Jericho. Palestinian flag looks, a green top and black RAZE shorts frame an IA tattoo. A distant smoke cloud is part of this fictional AI scene, not a report of a real event.

assets.alt: Four fictional adult women lean together on a terrace above Wadi Qelt's pale canyon, with a supported head-on-shoulder rest and joined hands. Flag-patterned and green short looks pair with sheer star knee-highs, red heels, rainbow ankle boots and green boots.

Four fictional adult women sit and lean into a linked-hand moment at a guarded Piha overlook above the black-sand beach and Lion Rock. Short black, white, red and New Zealand flag looks pair with rainbow boots, sculptural blue platforms and visible Silent King and star tattoos.
